evidence: Design: approved dash/slide/slam; hooks verified in PlayerController.Start, FixedUpdate, MoveForce, CrouchOverride and CollisionController.Grounded. Tunable values are initial design choices, not runtime test results. Native slide vectors use slideSpeed minus crouch contribution, set once when native Sliding starts.

rows.slideEntry: press native crouch while moving on ground; sprint-to-slide also works
